newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares in doldrums, few rises seen.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares in doldrums, few rises seen.

text.p: Lithuanian shares slipped back into the doldrums at the close of trade on Wednesday, with turnover down and bourse indices mixed.
Dealers said the market was on hold and would probably stay that way.
Turnover on the central market was a miserly 169,372 litas versus 390,000 litas.
The official list index added 0.81 percent to 888.18 but the more wide-ranging A group index lost 15.21 percent to 1869.04.

"Shares will remain at about the same levels and prices will not increase much this week. This is summer and I cannot see any good trends for an increase," Vilnius Bank broker Kestutis Kvainauskas said.
Among the few highlights, electronics maker Vilniaus Vingis traded more than 30,000 litas and lost 14 litas to 5.16.
Dealers said a share issue was weighing on the price and that its outlook anyway was not very good.
One trader noted that the group made a loss in the first four months although sales rose.
Second-largest bank Hermis was active again on trade of 22,748 litas but was unchanged at 188 litas.
